jobs.title: Bioinformatics Engineer
jobs.description:
Bioinformatics Engineer – Generative AI, Genotypes & Clinical Data

About Mind Moves

Mind Moves is a women-owned Washington, D.C.-based firm helping businesses and governments to embrace, build and deploy ‘human in the loop’ AI solutions to elevate mission and value. We are pioneers with deep expertise in the field of machine learning and AI (both predictive and generative). We have delivered responsibly developed products and services that impact millions of users worldwide, while generating millions of dollars in revenue. We have worked with Fortune 500 corporations and large government entities in health care, supply chain management, financial services and life sciences. We apply a structured methodology and holistic approach to AI transformation and a broad spectrum of technical services centered in the harnessing of people, science and technology.

What you’ll be doing

Designing and building synthetic data generation pipelines that produce high-fidelity, statistically representative datasets modeled on sensitive, controlled-access data sources — without exposing real participant-level information. Your synthetic datasets will let cross-functional teams prototype, test, and red-team AI/agentic systems against realistic data conditions before those systems ever touch production, controlled-access repositories.

Working with Mind Moves

You’ll collaborate with the Principal Investigator/Technical Lead, Biomedical Privacy & Gateway Engineer, Red-Team/Adversarial Security Lead, Cybersecurity Engineer, and the broader Mind Moves project team — while working closely with institutional stakeholders and Data Access Committees at NIH. This role offers the chance to:

Make a measurable impact on how safely AI systems handling sensitive genomic and health data can be developed and tested.
Gain hands-on experience with privacy-preserving data generation for frontier AI/ML pipelines.
Operate at the intersection of data engineering, privacy, and federal data governance in a creative, mission-driven environment.

The contract will include:

Design and build synthetic data generation pipelines (statistical modeling, generative models, or agent-based simulation) that replicate the structure and statistical properties of controlled-access datasets
Generate realistic synthetic test/dev datasets (e.g., genomic sequence-style data modeled on dbGaP) to support prototyping, MVP development, and red-team testing without exposing real participant-level data
Apply and tune privacy-preserving techniques, including differential privacy noise injection, to bound re-identification and membership-inference risk
Validate synthetic data fidelity — statistical distribution matching, utility-preservation testing, and downstream model performance parity against real data benchmarks
Assess and document residual privacy risk (e.g., re-identification, linkage, membership inference) for each synthetic dataset release
Collaborate with the Red-Team/Adversarial Security Lead and Biomedical Privacy & Gateway Engineer to supply adversarial and edge-case synthetic scenarios for testing
Contribute methodology documentation and data provenance records for review by institutional Data Access Committees (DACs)
Collaborate with cross-functional teams across federal agencies and supporting partners

Contractor has the following skills/background:

Demonstrated experience building synthetic data generation pipelines using statistical modeling, generative models (e.g., GANs, VAEs, diffusion), or agent-based simulation 
Experience engineering and transforming large-scale genomic formats (e.g., multi-sample VCFs, PLINK binary sets, Hail MatrixTables) alongside complex, longitudinal clinical and phenotypic data.
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience using synthetic data, privacy, and scientific libraries (e.g., Opacus, Diffprivlib, PyTorch, Hail, Polars, or Spark).
Data engineering and ETL skills — pipeline design, schema modeling, API integration
Knowledge of AI/data governance frameworks such as NIST AI RMF and federal (NIH/HHS) compliance requirements preferred
Background or experience in biomedical, bioinformatics, or life sciences preferred
Experience taking synthetic data pipelines from proof of concept through to production-grade, reusable tooling
Strong communication skills; ability to document methodology and risk assessments for non-technical and institutional stakeholders
Must be located in the US and authorized to work in the US without sponsorship, now or in the future
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a federal public trust credential / government badge.

Proposal Details

Compensation range: 
$100-130/hr
Estimated contract duration:
3 months
Contract hours:
20-25 hours/week
Work locale:
Remote (EST time zone preferred)
To apply:
Please complete the short application and upload your resume.

Timeline and Process:
Proposals are accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled. The contract bid process will include 3 interviews and the invitation to complete a technical exercise.

jobs.title: Lead Finance Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About The Role

In the role of Lead Finance Data Analyst, you will report to the Vice President, Accounting Systems and Data Governance.

We are considering applicants for our Los Angeles, California office.

You will lead the analysis, governance, validation, and integration of finance data used across accounting, reporting, and finance systems. You will partner with Accounting, Finance, Technology, and business teams to define trusted data standards, strengthen SOX-relevant controls, resolve data quality issues, and support changes to financial systems and interfaces. The role combines hands-on data analysis with process and control leadership to help ensure finance data is accurate, complete, timely, traceable, and fit for downstream use. Success will be measured by improved data quality, effective control execution, and reliable delivery of finance data changes across the system landscape.

Core Areas of Responsibility

Finance Data Governance: Establish and maintain finance data definitions, ownership, lineage, critical data elements, data quality rules, and governance standards across source systems, integrations, subledgers, ERP, and reporting environments.
Data Quality and Validation: Design and execute validation routines, reconciliations, exception monitoring, root-cause analysis, and remediation plans to improve the accuracy, completeness, cutoff, consistency, and traceability of finance data.
SOX Controls and Auditability: Partner with control owners to design, document, operate, and improve SOX controls over finance data, interfaces, system-generated reports, master data, and change activity; maintain evidence and support audit and testing requests.
System Integration and Change Delivery: Define finance data requirements and validation criteria for new or changed integrations, interfaces, transformations, and system implementations; coordinate user acceptance testing, cutover, defect resolution, and post-production validation.
Change Management and Stakeholder Partnership: Assess impacts of data and process changes, coordinate communications, training, and procedures, and lead cross-functional issue resolution to drive adoption while minimizing control, reporting, and operational disruption.

About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

You have 8+ years of experience in finance data, accounting systems, financial systems analysis, data governance, or related roles, including ownership of complex cross-functional initiatives.
You have a strong understanding of accounting data flows and financial reporting requirements, including how transactions move from operational systems through integrations and subledgers into the general ledger and reporting environments.
You have hands-on experience with finance data governance, including data definitions, ownership, lineage, critical data elements, data quality controls, metadata, and issue remediation.
You have experience designing, executing, or supporting SOX controls over financial systems, interfaces, reports, master data, or data changes, and understand control documentation, evidence, and audit testing expectations.
You possess advanced data validation and reconciliation skills, including SQL-based analysis and structured testing of large financial datasets.
You have experience with system integration and data transformation concepts, including source-to-target mapping, interface controls, file- and API-based integrations, error handling, and downstream reconciliation.
You have led or materially supported system change initiatives, including requirements, user acceptance testing, cutover, post-implementation validation, process documentation, and change management.
You have experience with ERP and finance platforms such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Concur, or comparable systems.
You possess strong analytical judgment and can translate accounting, control, and reporting requirements into scalable data and system requirements.
You have a bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field; CPA, CISA, or recognized data governance certifications are a plus.

About The Team

The Accounting Systems and Data Governance team connects accounting requirements, data standards, controls, and technology to support reliable, scalable financial operations. The team partners across Accounting, Finance, Technology, and business functions to strengthen finance data integrity and improve how financial information moves through Crunchyroll's systems. This role is a senior individual contributor and key point of coordination for finance data governance, validation, and change initiatives. Success is measured through trusted data, effective controls, and dependable system delivery.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.
Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.
Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance
Health Saving Account HSA program
Health care and dependent care FSA
401(k) plan, with employer match
Employer paid commuter benefit
Support program for new parents
Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!

Other rewards may include performance bonuses, employer matched retirement savings, time-off programs, and progressive health benefits and perks.

About Our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

Produce detailed survey drawings, including topographic surveys, boundary surveys, ALTA/NSPS surveys, right-of-way exhibits, construction stakeouts, and as-built documentation.

Ensure compliance with company, municipal, and industry CAD standards.

Perform quality control checks on deliverables and assist in maintaining drafting consistency across projects.

Qualifications

Minimum 3 years of CAD drafting experience with a focus on Civil 3D.
Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D 2021 or newer, including surfaces, alignments, profiles, points, and data management.
Demonstrated experience preparing accurate and professional as-built drawings.
Working knowledge of land surveying principles and the ability to draft legal descriptions.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills and ability to collaborate in a team environment.
Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
Read and understand project documents.

jobs.description:
Notice: This position does NOT work remotely.

Position Purpose

The Data Analyst will be responsible for the development, testing, implementation, and maintenance of Health Hub data and recurring reports as well as dashboards and other business intelligence applications that utilize the underlying data stores for internal and external use under the Health Hub Program. This includes tracking encounter and quality outcome data from electronic health records (NextGen), i2i, HMIS, Microsoft Office platforms, and health plan reports.

The Data Analyst will also support multidisciplinary teams, including medical providers, nursing, behavioral health, case management, and administrative staff with data reporting needs. Reporting includes Capitation and Fee-for-Service (FFS) Reconciliation reports, monthly dashboards, provider productivity reports, and more. The Data Analyst will thoroughly analyze and clarify report requirements, make recommendations, and provide education when necessary to meet business needs. They will also be responsible for creating and maintaining internal controls and reference materials to promote data quality.

Principal Responsibilities

Design, develop, maintain, and troubleshoot data systems and databases, including identifying and correcting coding errors, data discrepancies, and other data-related issues to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
Collect, analyze, report, and monitor encounter data and quality outcome measures from NextGen, i2i, health plan reporting systems, and other applicable data sources to support Health Hub Program requirements.
Extract, organize, clean, and transform data from primary and secondary sources into meaningful formats that support organizational decision-making, program evaluation, and reporting requirements for county contractors and other stakeholders.
Apply statistical methods and analytical tools to interpret datasets, identify trends and patterns, and support diagnostic, predictive, and performance improvement analyses.
Evaluate and interpret data within the context of local, national, and industry-wide trends to identify potential impacts, opportunities, and challenges affecting the organization and its programs.
Prepare reports for program directors and executive leadership that clearly communicate trends, patterns, and predictions using relevant data.
Collaborate with programmers, IT staff, and organizational leaders to identify opportunities for process improvement, recommend system modifications, and support the development of data governance policies.
Collaborate and coordinate with internal stakeholders and external consultants within the data network to extract, evaluate, and deliver data requested by county representatives on a monthly and quarterly basis.
Develop and maintain clear documentation of data collection, extraction, validation, and analysis methodologies to support transparency, reproducibility, and verification of reported information.
Develop, update, and maintain data reference materials, including data dictionaries, codebooks, reporting specifications, and standardized documentation to promote consistency and accuracy across reporting processes.
Design, develop, implement, and maintain business intelligence dashboards and data visualizations using a user-centered design approach to ensure information is clear, accessible, accurate, and meaningful to the intended audience.
Coordinate the ordering, inventory tracking, monitoring, and replenishment of medical supplies and other program-related materials requested by Program Directors, ensuring requests are processed and fulfilled in accordance with established organizational procedures.
Adhere to all organizational safety policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements to ensure a safe environment for patients, staff, and visitors.
Participate in required safety and compliance training and apply learned practices in daily work activities.
Identify, report, and help mitigate unsafe conditions, incidents, or hazards in the workplace.
Use equipment, tools, and supplies safely and responsibly in accordance with organizational and regulatory standards.
Maintain awareness of infection control, occupational health, and emergency preparedness procedures appropriate to the role.
Participate in JWCH’s customer service training called AIDET on an annual basis.
Demonstrate an understanding of AIDET (Acknowledge, Introduce, Duration, Explanation, and Thank You) to apply in patient encounters or team discussions.
Utilize the AIDET communication framework to communicate with patients and team members in a manner that reduces patient anxiety, increases patient compliance, and improves clinical outcomes.

Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Minimum of two years of demonstrated experience working as a Data Analyst, Data Specialist, or in a data management and reporting support role, preferably in a healthcare, behavioral health, or nonprofit setting.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365 applications, with demonstrated experience using databases and analytical tools, including macros, Visual Basic for Applications (VBA), pivot tables, pivot charts, queries, and data filters.
Experience working with NextGen Electronic Health Records (EHR) or a comparable electronic medical records (EMR) system, including the ability to develop, execute, and maintain data queries and reports.
Experience using web-based data reporting portals, secure file transfer protocols (SFTP), and other platforms for data exchange, retrieval, and reporting.
Knowledge of healthcare data management, reporting requirements, and applicable federal, state, and local funding requirements related to healthcare services.

Knowledge, Skills And Ability

Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into meaningful insights.
Demonstrated ability to collect, organize, validate, analyze, and communicate large volumes of information with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams, organizational leadership, external consultants, and community partners.
Experience working in a nonprofit, healthcare, or human services environment preferred.
All JWCH, Wesley Health Centers workforce members are recommended to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19.

Employee Benefits

At JWCH Institute, Inc., we believe in taking care of those who take care of others. If you work 30+ hours per week, you’ll enjoy competitive pay and a robust benefits package that includes:

Become part of a team where your work matters. Apply today and help us change lives, one patient at a time.

jobs.description:
Location - Vista, CA - On Site

Salary - $27/Hour to $31/Hour

About Nordic Naturals

At Nordic Naturals, we take pride in crafting foundational nutrients to help people all over the world live healthy lives. Our mission is to give people, pets, and families the highest-quality nutrients possible to be well and support optimal health. This seemingly simple mission of global health relies on a dedicated team of motivated employees who share our passion for nutrition and wellness. Join us and discover how rewarding it can be to make a living while contributing to a truly great cause.

Position Summary

The R&D Pilot Lab Technician
supports the development, optimization, and scale‑up of softgel processes within the Product Development pilot facility. This role is responsible for preparing and executing pilot‑scale softgel batches, operating and maintaining pilot equipment, performing analytical and in‑process testing, and documenting trial results with high accuracy. As the softgel pilot lab is newly established, the Technician will help develop lab workflows, SOPs, batch records, and equipment readiness under the guidance of the Senior R&D Process Engineer. The position also supports material qualification activities by conducting pilot‑scale evaluations, collecting data, and preparing samples to inform technical assessments within PD.

Essential Functions & Core Responsibilities

Softgel Pilot Execution & Equipment Operation

Prepare and execute pilot‑scale softgel batches (including gelatin prep, fill formulation, encapsulation, drying) with increasing independence and strong attention to process parameters.
Operate, clean, tear down, and maintain softgel pilot equipment; perform basic troubleshooting and identify mechanical or process issues for escalation within PD.
Conduct in‑process and analytical testing (viscosity, density, fill weight, moisture, gel strength, pH) and prepare samples for QA, stability, or external laboratory evaluation.

Pilot Lab Setup, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

Support development and maintenance of pilot lab workflows, SOPs, batch records, equipment logs, and cleaning procedures for softgel operations.
Maintain pilot lab inventory of raw materials, consumables, and testing instruments; ensure readiness and 5S organization across the lab.
Contribute to small process improvement initiatives and support RCA/CAPA investigations through accurate data collection, documentation, and process observations, within the pilot lab environment.

Engineering Trial Support & PD Collaboration

Execute small‑scale engineering trials under guidance, including parameter tracking, sampling, data logging, and trial documentation to support DOE, center-lining, and process capability assessments.
Work closely with PD Formulators and the Senior R&D Process Engineer to support softgel development, scale‑up readiness, and business‑sustaining technical activities.
Communicate equipment issues, process risks, and trial outcomes to PD engineering leadership to support ongoing pilot lab development and optimization.

Must be able to read and interpret documents such as standard operating procedures, and regulations

Ability to deal with complex problems with many variables
Basic skills in math, including algebra are required

new_jobs.description:
Bioinformatics Engineer – Generative AI, Genotypes & Clinical Data

About Mind Moves

Mind Moves is a women-owned Washington, D.C.-based firm helping businesses and governments to embrace, build and deploy ‘human in the loop’ AI solutions to elevate mission and value. We are pioneers with deep expertise in the field of machine learning and AI (both predictive and generative). We have delivered responsibly developed products and services that impact millions of users worldwide, while generating millions of dollars in revenue. We have worked with Fortune 500 corporations and large government entities in health care, supply chain management, financial services and life sciences. We apply a structured methodology and holistic approach to AI transformation and a broad spectrum of technical services centered in the harnessing of people, science and technology.

What you’ll be doing

Designing and building synthetic data generation pipelines that produce high-fidelity, statistically representative datasets modeled on sensitive, controlled-access data sources — without exposing real participant-level information. Your synthetic datasets will let cross-functional teams prototype, test, and red-team AI/agentic systems against realistic data conditions before those systems ever touch production, controlled-access repositories.

Working with Mind Moves

You’ll collaborate with the Principal Investigator/Technical Lead, Biomedical Privacy & Gateway Engineer, Red-Team/Adversarial Security Lead, Cybersecurity Engineer, and the broader Mind Moves project team — while working closely with institutional stakeholders and Data Access Committees at NIH. This role offers the chance to:

Make a measurable impact on how safely AI systems handling sensitive genomic and health data can be developed and tested.
Gain hands-on experience with privacy-preserving data generation for frontier AI/ML pipelines.
Operate at the intersection of data engineering, privacy, and federal data governance in a creative, mission-driven environment.

The contract will include:

Design and build synthetic data generation pipelines (statistical modeling, generative models, or agent-based simulation) that replicate the structure and statistical properties of controlled-access datasets
Generate realistic synthetic test/dev datasets (e.g., genomic sequence-style data modeled on dbGaP) to support prototyping, MVP development, and red-team testing without exposing real participant-level data
Apply and tune privacy-preserving techniques, including differential privacy noise injection, to bound re-identification and membership-inference risk
Validate synthetic data fidelity — statistical distribution matching, utility-preservation testing, and downstream model performance parity against real data benchmarks
Assess and document residual privacy risk (e.g., re-identification, linkage, membership inference) for each synthetic dataset release
Collaborate with the Red-Team/Adversarial Security Lead and Biomedical Privacy & Gateway Engineer to supply adversarial and edge-case synthetic scenarios for testing
Contribute methodology documentation and data provenance records for review by institutional Data Access Committees (DACs)
Collaborate with cross-functional teams across federal agencies and supporting partners

Contractor has the following skills/background:

Demonstrated experience building synthetic data generation pipelines using statistical modeling, generative models (e.g., GANs, VAEs, diffusion), or agent-based simulation 
Experience engineering and transforming large-scale genomic formats (e.g., multi-sample VCFs, PLINK binary sets, Hail MatrixTables) alongside complex, longitudinal clinical and phenotypic data.
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience using synthetic data, privacy, and scientific libraries (e.g., Opacus, Diffprivlib, PyTorch, Hail, Polars, or Spark).
Data engineering and ETL skills — pipeline design, schema modeling, API integration
Knowledge of AI/data governance frameworks such as NIST AI RMF and federal (NIH/HHS) compliance requirements preferred
Background or experience in biomedical, bioinformatics, or life sciences preferred
Experience taking synthetic data pipelines from proof of concept through to production-grade, reusable tooling
Strong communication skills; ability to document methodology and risk assessments for non-technical and institutional stakeholders
Must be located in the US and authorized to work in the US without sponsorship, now or in the future

About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About The Role

In the role of Lead Finance Data Analyst, you will report to the Vice President, Accounting Systems and Data Governance.

We are considering applicants for our Los Angeles, California office.

You will lead the analysis, governance, validation, and integration of finance data used across accounting, reporting, and finance systems. You will partner with Accounting, Finance, Technology, and business teams to define trusted data standards, strengthen SOX-relevant controls, resolve data quality issues, and support changes to financial systems and interfaces. The role combines hands-on data analysis with process and control leadership to help ensure finance data is accurate, complete, timely, traceable, and fit for downstream use. Success will be measured by improved data quality, effective control execution, and reliable delivery of finance data changes across the system landscape.

Core Areas of Responsibility

Finance Data Governance: Establish and maintain finance data definitions, ownership, lineage, critical data elements, data quality rules, and governance standards across source systems, integrations, subledgers, ERP, and reporting environments.
Data Quality and Validation: Design and execute validation routines, reconciliations, exception monitoring, root-cause analysis, and remediation plans to improve the accuracy, completeness, cutoff, consistency, and traceability of finance data.
SOX Controls and Auditability: Partner with control owners to design, document, operate, and improve SOX controls over finance data, interfaces, system-generated reports, master data, and change activity; maintain evidence and support audit and testing requests.
System Integration and Change Delivery: Define finance data requirements and validation criteria for new or changed integrations, interfaces, transformations, and system implementations; coordinate user acceptance testing, cutover, defect resolution, and post-production validation.
Change Management and Stakeholder Partnership: Assess impacts of data and process changes, coordinate communications, training, and procedures, and lead cross-functional issue resolution to drive adoption while minimizing control, reporting, and operational disruption.

About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

You have 8+ years of experience in finance data, accounting systems, financial systems analysis, data governance, or related roles, including ownership of complex cross-functional initiatives.
You have a strong understanding of accounting data flows and financial reporting requirements, including how transactions move from operational systems through integrations and subledgers into the general ledger and reporting environments.
You have hands-on experience with finance data governance, including data definitions, ownership, lineage, critical data elements, data quality controls, metadata, and issue remediation.

You have experience with system integration and data transformation concepts, including source-to-target mapping, interface controls, file- and API-based integrations, error handling, and downstream reconciliation.
You have led or materially supported system change initiatives, including requirements, user acceptance testing, cutover, post-implementation validation, process documentation, and change management.
You have experience with ERP and finance platforms such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Concur, or comparable systems.
You possess strong analytical judgment and can translate accounting, control, and reporting requirements into scalable data and system requirements.
You have a bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field; CPA, CISA, or recognized data governance certifications are a plus.

About The Team

The Accounting Systems and Data Governance team connects accounting requirements, data standards, controls, and technology to support reliable, scalable financial operations. The team partners across Accounting, Finance, Technology, and business functions to strengthen finance data integrity and improve how financial information moves through Crunchyroll's systems. This role is a senior individual contributor and key point of coordination for finance data governance, validation, and change initiatives. Success is measured through trusted data, effective controls, and dependable system delivery.

The Clinical Laboratory Scientist performs a variety of standardized and highly specialized analysis of tests in Chemistry, Immunology, Hematology, Coagulation, Urinalysis, Microbiology and/or Blood Bank. The Clinical Laboratory Scientist is responsible for the accuracy, reliability and timeliness of patient test results (pre-analytical, analytical and post-analytical) used for the diagnosis, management and treatment of patients.

Provides support and facilitates communications by effectively navigating computer and phone systems, building and maintaining customer relationships, and providing a positive, professional and empathetic understanding to all customers.

Role Description
The Research Assistant role at Sterling PMC is a part-time, remote position focused on supporting project teams with research and analysis across real estate and project management topics. Day-to-day tasks include gathering and synthesizing information from industry reports, academic sources, and project documentation, and preparing concise summaries, briefs, and presentations for internal stakeholders. The role involves assisting with data collection and basic data analysis to help evaluate project performance, market trends, and client requirements. The Research Assistant will collaborate with project managers to organize research findings, maintain databases and records, and contribute to the preparation of proposals and client-facing materials. This position requires effective remote communication, proactive time management, and the ability to work independently while supporting multiple projects.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Research and Analytical Skills to gather, evaluate, and interpret complex information.
Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication for reports and presentations.
Candidates should possess Data Analysis skills, including comfort with spreadsheets and basic quantitative methods.
Candidates should possess Laboratory Skills or equivalent applied research experience where methodical data collection and documentation are required.
Relevant qualifications may include a degree or current studies in fields such as project management, engineering, real estate, business, or a related discipline.
Ability to work remotely with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and proficiency in common productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Office, online collaboration platforms).
Interest in the built environment, real estate, or project management, and willingness to learn sector-specific concepts and standards.
